CHAPTER I

The morning came in slowly over the roofs of the town, and a cart went past
below the window and did not stop at any door.

He counted the panes of glass twice over, and then a third time, because the
counting was easier than the waiting had been, and because nobody had yet
come down the stairs to tell him otherwise.


A word that is quite unreasonably long follows: antidisestablishmentarianism,
and the wrapper has to break it rather than run past the edge of the page.

CHAPTER II

Later there would be work, and the relief of it, and the ordinary noise of
other people going about their own mornings as though nothing had happened.
